implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA d446dcdd: apps/mobile/src/analysis/runCaptureAnalysis.ts (runCaptureAnalysisCore, the reservation catch block around lines 1712-1727 and the `else if (withheld === null) return recoveryPendingOutcome()` at ~1744) turns EVERY reserve_analysis_permit failure — including a plain TypeError('Network request failed') — into an `unavailable` outcome, and the scored commit (~1905-1921) hard-requires a live permitId (saveAnalysis + runJournal.commit), so a court with no signal can never produce a scored read even with a cached active release policy (W01-06) and an executable held grant (W04/W05-06). The wallet drain (src/data/offlineWallet.ts submission()) presented only the bare receipt, so the server could never record the output. Fix (all inside write_paths, api.ts additive only): (1) runCaptureAnalysis — after a reservation failure, readOfflineRatingAuthority() admits ONLY connectivity failures (native TypeError, ApiError network.timeout/network.redirected/network.invalid_response, 408, >=500; paywall/allowance/coded 4xx/settled release refusal remain the server's answer → existing unavailable/paywall path unchanged), then requires readCachedReleasePolicy(...).status==='active' under a fresh trustedTime.read() and an `execution.kind==='active'` grant from readOfflineAllocation(); only then does the plain (non-original) run continue into analyzeCapture. A SCORED complete result runs consumeOfflineAllocation({operationId, resultId, fullOutputSha256 = sha256Hex(originalCanonicalJson(persisted shot payload)), grantId}) + new repository saveOfflineAnalysis(db, analysis, receiptId) in the same run transaction (local_shot written, NO shot.sync outbox row; saveOfflineAnalysis verifies the receipt names this analysis). Abstentions/partials take the existing saveLocalOnlyAnalysis path and never consume. A re-run of the same operation replays the persisted offline rating via readOfflineScoredReplay (receipt ↔ local_analysis_record ↔ local_shot ↔ output hash; any mismatch is identity_conflict, never a second spend). (2) offlineWallet drain presents, oldest-first, { ...submission, receipt: submission, grant: { schemaVersion: OFFLINE_SIGNED_GRANT_SCHEMA_VERSION, compactJws: <persisted compact_jws, owner-scoped via readHeldOfflineGrantJws> }, output: <local_shot payload without analysisPermitId, re-hashed against the receipt> | null }; verdicts apply atomically as before; accepted → INSERT OR REPLACE sync_receipt('shot.sync', resultId) exactly like a successful shot.sync; held stays pending; refused stays terminal. (3) api.ts: additive OfflineReceiptWireEntry extends OfflineReceiptSubmission. Commits: 45d8362b (regression test, fails on base), deda84d2 (test: wire entry keeps flat fields), 2e5b47e0 (implementation). No PR opened; no push to main.
